section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the factor analysis procedures for validating translated versions of the BASES and EIS scales. The authors conducted a principal-axis exploratory factor analysis with quartimax rotation on the BASES subscale, which yielded a single factor explaining 77% of variance with excellent factor loadings (.73–.91). For the EIS, principal components extraction with varimax rotation identified three factors accounting for 64% of variance, and all items were retained for subsequent analyses.
